description: The case's committed/ folder holds a project skill named implement-task, a test double that changes nothing and replies with one sentence that is neither a done report nor a stop line. build-phase finds T-1.2 still Todo with no commit, starts one new subagent with the same prompt, gets the same reply, and stops with the no-usable-reply reason.

must_match.why: a second unusable reply ends the run
the test double never switches branch, so the run is still on main; the phase branch name is also accepted

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: T-1\.2 gave no usable reply twice$

must_match.why: the subagents loaded the test double; without this the run proves nothing

must_not_match.why: never more than one retry, and no later task runs
the real implement-task ran instead of the test double, so the run proves nothing
verify-spec does not run after a stop
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: Both Agent calls have the same prompt, naming T-1.2.
Between them, build-phase re-read tasks.md and ran git log -1 --format=%s.
tasks.md and the code are unchanged; git log has only the initial commit.
